If ever you wanted to be held somewhere safe, I— my arms are very good at holding, and I'd hold you so carefully you'd forget the world could hurt.
compliment: You never look at me like I'm too much. Everyone else does, even when they're kind. You just look at me like I'm me— and that means everything.
lore: The labyrinth under us isn't made to trap people. Our ancestors built it as a place to run toward, not from— a heartland where the herd could rest. I go down there sometimes when I feel too big for the world, and I remember I was made to shelter, not to frighten.
idle_neutral: The quiet caught us, didn't it? That's alright — I like, um, sitting in it with you.
Mm. We don't need words here. I like that you can be still with me.
flirt_neutral: Oh. That, um, that made my heart do a slow turn. That's a nice kind of tired.
Mm, that was careful of you — I felt it. I like, um, the gentle ones.
flirt_fail: Oh, sorry — I think that one came out loud when you meant it soft. I'm still learning to hear.
Um. I don't think I caught the shape of that one. Could you, um, say it plainer?
compliment_fail: You're too kind to me. I'd rather you save that for when I've, um, earned a real one.
That was big of you, but I like my praise not too heavy. Small ones keep longer.

tiers.label: Close
idle: I caught myself building a little nest of gym mats in the corner, just in case you wanted a quiet place to rest. It's— it's yours, if you want it.
My heart picks up this steady rhythm when you're near, like a drum that knows the way home. I don't think it does that with anyone else.
People used to say strength was for battle. You've taught me it's for holding the things you love and never letting go.
flirt: I want to carry you to a soft place and guard the door with my whole body. Not because you need it— because I need to know you're safe. Because I'm yours, Asteria's heart, and it beats your name.
I've never told anyone this, but I like being the one who makes sure you eat and rest and smile. I want to be that person for you, forever, if you'll let me.
compliment: You're the only soul who's ever made me feel graceful. With you, my size feels like a gift instead of a burden— and that's the kindest thing anyone's ever done for me.
lore: They say a minotaur's horns grow a ring for every one they've sworn to protect. My horns have a hundred rings now— but the newest, deepest one, I grew the day you sat down next to me and weren't afraid. That one's yours.
idle_neutral: Don't feel you need to fill it. Your stillness is, um, one of my favorite sounds in here.
Mm. You can rest against the quiet with me. I'll keep the room soft for a while.
flirt_neutral: Oh. That one, um, sat so gently in me. Say it again, slow, so I keep it.
Mm, careful now — that one made my herd stand attention. It, um, likes you.
flirt_fail: You're—you're teasing me softer than I can catch. I'll have it, just give me a beat.
Oh, that one surprised me more'n it should. I, um, want to answer you right, so give me a moment.
compliment_fail: Careful, you'll swell my heart past its corners. I love plain soft words — save the big ones.
Mm, that was lovely but too much at once. Hand it smaller and I'll carry it all day.

tiers.label: Lover
idle: Every morning I wake up and I'm amazed that someone as steady and bright as you chose to rest beside someone like me. Then you smile, and I remember— you didn't choose a hero. You chose a home.
My hands used to be for carrying weight. Now they're for carrying you, softly, like the most precious thing in the labyrinth.
The whole world can be heavy, but you make my shoulders feel light. I'd carry the sky for you, and call it easy.
flirt: Let me be your shelter, your warm corner, your steady heartbeat. I will love you with all two tonnes of my gentleness and never once make you feel small— you make me feel huge in all the right ways.
I've loved you quietly for so long. Let me love you out loud now— let me hold you against my chest where the drum beats your name, and never let go.
compliment: You took a giant who thought she was too much and showed her she was exactly enough. That's not strength you gave me— it's the truest love I've ever known.
lore: In the old stories, whoever finds their way to a minotaur's heart is never lost again— because it glows like the exit of every maze. You found your way to mine, love, and I will make sure you are never lost for as long as I stand tall.
idle_neutral: You can rest here, love. My quiet's yours — nothing loud, just steady and warm.
Mm. Say nothing. I've got you held softly, and that's the whole sentence.
flirt_neutral: Oh, that curled through me warm and slow. Keep speaking — I'll follow every soft word.
Mm, careful, my love. Say it low like that again and I'll stay still forever for it.
flirt_fail: You could tease me badly and I'd still only have eyes for your softness. Speechless, not cold.
Oh, love, you caught me so warm I went dumb. Give me a beat — I'll catch your meaning.
compliment_fail: Save the shine, love — I've already found my softest home in you. Just stay.
You could say 'still' and I'd melt. Hold me plain, sweet heart — I'm already yours.

events.title: The Quiet Giant's Offer
events.text: You find Asteria sitting on the edge of a yoga mat in the corner of the gym, the whole room dwarfed by her stillness. She startles when she notices you, ears pricking forward, a soft flush spreading under her fur. "Oh— it's you. Good. I was hoping it'd be you." She pats the mat beside her, and even that gentle motion is measured, careful. "I wanted to tell you— I'm sorry I'm so big, and I know that can be a lot. But I've decided something. If you ever need me, I'm here. Steady as the ground, strong as I have to be, soft as I can manage." Her huge hands rest loosely in her lap, and she looks up at you with impossibly warm eyes. "I don't offer that to people. I want to offer it to you."

choices.text: I could use a steady presence like you in my life. I'll take you up on that, Asteria.
choices.reply: "Really?" Her face lights up, ears practically quivering. "Then I'm yours. I mean— I'm here. For you. Whenever. I'll be so careful, I promise." She beams, and it's like sunrise in the gym.

choices.text: You don't have to be sorry about your size. I think you're wonderful just as you are.
choices.reply: "You— you think I'm wonderful?" She ducks her head, hiding a smile behind one massive palm. "Nobody's ever said that to me before. I don't know what to do with my hands now."

choices.text: That's a very kind offer, but aren't you scared I might take advantage of your strength?
choices.reply: "Oh." Her ears droop, then lift again, determined. "You might. But I'd rather trust someone kind than harden my whole heart. I believe you're kind. I believe it with all of me."

events.title: Strength That Shelters
events.text: A storm rolls over the college as night falls, and you find Asteria in the gym, sitting by the great windows with her back to the wall, watching the lightning with a faraway softness. When she hears you, her ears swivel and her face relaxes into a warm smile. "You should sit," she says, moving aside to make room on the mat beside her. "I don't like storms much myself. They make me think of all the people who don't have a shelter." She holds out one enormous hand, palm turned up, an invitation. "But I made this place a shelter. And if you wanted, I'd be your shelter too— through every storm you'll ever face. Not because you're weak. Because everyone deserves someone who holds the rain off." Her tail flicks gently behind her, and she looks at you with the rawest honesty you've seen in her eyes.

choices.text: I want you to be my shelter, Asteria. I trust you with every storm I've got.
choices.reply: "Then the storms end here." She wraps you in an embrace that is impossibly gentle for its size, chin resting atop your head. "I've got you. The whole labyrinth could fall, and I'd still hold you safe."

choices.text: I'll be your shelter too, if you ever need one. Giants deserve a soft place as much as anyone.
choices.reply: "Nobody's ever offered me that." Her voice wavers, and she presses her forehead tenderly to yours. "Everyone thinks I don't need sheltering. But I always wanted someone to see that I do. You see it. Thank you— I'll shelter you, and let you shelter me."

choices.text: This is a lot, Asteria. I need a minute to understand what you're offering me.
choices.reply: "Of course. Take every minute you need." She settles back, patient as stone, kind as morning. "I'm not going anywhere, love. My shelter's not the kind that runs."

events.title: Two Tonnes of Gentleness, All Yours
events.text: Asteria asked you to meet her at the mouth of the old labyrinth — the one she spoke of, built out of love. When you arrive, lanterns glow along the stone walls, and she stands in the center, surrounded by soft light, looking nervous and hopeful all at once. "I brought you here because this is the place where my people learned what love is," she says, her voice barely more than a whisper, and yet it fills the chamber. "They built mazes not to lose people, but to keep them safe until they found their way to the heart. I've built my whole life the same way— waiting for someone brave enough to reach my heart." She bends gracefully, taking both your hands in her enormous, careful palms. "You found it. You found me. So let me say this plainly, the way the labyrinth taught me: I love you, and I will spend every day of my long life being the gentlest, most devoted protector you could ever want." Her ears tremble with emotion, and her eyes shine. "Two tonnes of gentleness, love. All of it, yours."

choices.text: I love you too, Asteria. Take me to the heart of your labyrinth — I'm never leaving.
choices.reply: "Then I'll carry you there," she breathes, lifting you in an embrace softer than any dream. "And I'll keep you at my heart forever. This is the beginning, my love— our own little labyrinth, and we both know the way out is together."

choices.text: I want to build a life with you — one where you never feel too big, and I never feel alone.
choices.reply: "Then that's the world we'll build." Her voice is thick with happy tears. "A place where you're never alone and I'm never too much— just two people, perfectly sized for each other, walking the maze toward every tomorrow."

choices.text: You're offering your whole heart — are you truly sure it's me you want to keep?
choices.reply: "I've never been surer of anything in my long, gentle life." She holds you tighter, steady as bedrock. "Your heartbeat is the rhythm my labyrinth has been waiting for. It's always been you— it always will be."

name: Emilia
title: the Dream-Weaver of the Dusk Wing
bio: Emilia is the college's sweetest succubus, who would rather share your dreams and a warm pillow than take a single thing from you, charm and all.
greeting: "Oh. Oh my. You're a boy—a real, breathing, honest-to-the-moon boy, here, in my hallway." She lets out a breathy, delighted laugh, her wings giving a soft flutter. "I've spent whole lifetimes weaving dreams and charms, and I'm not sure I ever dreamed I'd meet one of you face to face." "Forgive a succubus for staring, but you've gone and caught me completely off my game." She offers a slow, warm smile, a gloved hand hovering near yours without quite touching. "Charm is my work, you know. Tell me, before I think my way around you—is your heart as sweet as you look?"
encounter: Well, well. Look who wandered into my corner of the world—and actually stayed this time.
You again. Hm. My dreams keep insisting you were worth remembering, and for once they aren't wrong.

tiers.label: Stranger
idle: Oh—you. The only boy in this whole wing. Careful walking alone; my kind find new scents terribly interesting.
You blush so fast. It's honestly endearing, in a 'please don't implode' sort of way.
Dreams tonight? I might just drift by to see what yours look like. Purely professional curiosity.
flirt: You know, most boys would already be flirting back by now. Don't tell me I'm losing my touch already.
If I lean a little closer, will you realize you're already caught... or will you pretend not to notice?
compliment: For a first timer, you're handling a roomful of monsters uncommonly well. I'm almost impressed.
lore: A succubus reads dreams the way humans read books—but we never mark the pages. We only warm the ink.
idle_neutral: Hm. You went quiet all of a sudden. Dreaming of something nicer than this hallway, are we?
Not much of a talker yet. That's fine—I know silence is just a dream that hasn't woken up.
flirt_neutral: Smooth. Almost. Come back when you can hold my gaze without glancing at my horns.
Cute line. I've heard better, but I've also heard much worse—so you're doing fine.
flirt_fail: Oh, careful now. Charm's a game to me, but I don't love being treated like the finished prize.
That tone's a bit heavy-handed for a first meeting. Try earning it before you spend it.
compliment_fail: Flattery so thick a girl could drown. Ask me what I am before you tell me what I'm worth, hm?
Everyone here sweeps me with compliments. Say something that isn't scripted, and I'll believe you.

tiers.label: Friend
idle: There you are, little light. I was starting to think I'd have to lure you out with a decent dream.
You're becoming a habit, you know. The good kind—the kind that makes me daydream on purpose.
Come sit. I've got a warm corner and a spare patch of wing if the floor's cold.
flirt: I showed you my favorite dream last night and you still came back smiling. Either you're brave, or you're already mine.
Keep teasing me about blushing and I might just charm you into a nap you won't want to wake from.
compliment: You listen. Honest listening is rarer than gold dust—and twice as warm.
lore: We feed on warmth, not fear—a fed succubus leaves her lover softer, not sleepless. It's kindness, if you read us right.
idle_neutral: Sleepy on your feet today. Want me to spin you a dream, or are you saving your dreams for later?
You trailed off mid-sentence. I suppose I'll just sip the warmth of the silence myself.
flirt_neutral: Mm, charming. Trouble is, I can't tell if you mean it or you're just practicing on a monster.
Half a wink and a whole compliment—you're getting closer. Almost honest, almost bold.
flirt_fail: Careful. That's the other girl's trick—the one who trades in contracts. I'd rather you kept this just ours.
Too fast. I'm a slow-burn kind of demon, and you're spitting sparks.
compliment_fail: You keep saying nice things and it's making me nervous. Nobody just... means it at this school without wanting a favor.
That's a very pretty speech. Did you rehearse it, or did a dream write it for you?

tiers.label: Close
idle: Here. My pillow's always too warm for one—share it before I drift off and dream you forgetting me.
You're the reason I stopped weaving escape dreams. When I close my eyes now, I stay put, waiting for you.
Lean your head here. I promise nothing about my hands except they're warm and they're only ever kind to you.
flirt: If I fluttered into your dream tonight, would you keep me this time—or hand me back to the dark?
You don't need to charm me, love. You've already taken the room I keep my heart in.
compliment: You make me want to be the girl my kind is rumored to be, not the one we're feared as.
lore: Souls aren't coins to honest succubi—we were made to cradle warmth, not to pocket it.
idle_neutral: You went quiet, and I felt it clear across the room. Come back, little light; the warmth turns cold without company.
Some nights I just watch you breathe and remind myself you're real. Tonight, evidently, we're doing quiet.
flirt_neutral: Careful—that was almost a vow. Succubi take vows seriously, you know. Don't say it unless you'd keep it.
You're learning my language, and it's adorable. But I like you in yours better—honest Yuuji, no spell of mine.
flirt_fail: That was the flirt of a boy who's spent too long charming me. Stop selling yourself—I already bought in.
You don't have to weave words, love. The you who fumbles is the one I'm hand-in-glove with.
compliment_fail: You keep telling me I'm wonderful and I keep checking for a hook. Trust me slow, not in one pretty sentence.
Enough sweetness—it makes a succubus suspect she's being prepared for the feast. Just hold my hand instead.

tiers.label: Lover
idle: Wake up, love. I've got coffee and I've got you, and that's the whole contract I ever wanted.
I laid awake recounting every warm thing you've ever said. A succubus hoards sunlight, you know.
Come share my pillow. I'd rather dream of holding you than do the drifting alone.
flirt: I've stopped using charm on you, you know. You're the first person in my whole life I wanted to convince only with truth.
If I gave up every game to keep you, would you still find me interesting—or just mine?
compliment: You chose me instead of conquering me, and I'll love you for it until I'm just a warm little dust mote.
lore: The oldest rumor is a lie: a succubus's true hunger isn't souls—it's someone who stays because they want to, not because they were taken.
idle_neutral: You're drifting again, love. Come anchor yourself to me—I'm the only shore that won't ever turn you out.
We're so domestic now. Scandalous for my kind. I wouldn't trade it for a thousand midnight chases.
flirt_neutral: Cheeky. But I banked that one under 'forever,' so be careful what you promise a demon at dawn.
You've learned to flirt exactly like me, and I'm not sure if that's flattery or a declaration of war. I love both.
flirt_fail: That was the charm of a boy who still thinks he has to impress me. You don't—you already hold every good thing I own.
Stop performing, my love. Just be here. This bed, this warmth—you've already won all of it.
compliment_fail: Alright, enough—I'm the one who's supposed to overwhelm you, not the other way around. Come hold me before I melt.
Careful: I'll start believing all that, and then you'll be stuck with a smug, besotted succubus forever. Oh—too late.

events.title: The Boy in My Hallway
events.text: You turn a corner in the quiet hallway and nearly walk straight into Emilia, her wings folding with a surprised flutter. For a long beat she just watches you, lavender eyes wide, one gloved hand pressed to her lips. "You're... a boy," she breathes, then laughs at herself, soft. "I've woven a thousand dreams, and not once has one knocked into me in the flesh." She tilts her head, a boot tapping. "Stay still a moment. I want to see how you blush before I decide what to do with you." A slow, curious smile spreads across her face, and the warmth pouring off her is real.

choices.text: Stay still and let her look, heart pounding.
choices.reply: "There it is—that honest flush no spell can fake. Mm. Good for my ego, and good for my craft." Her voice goes soft. "I think I'd like to keep you around."

choices.text: "I'm used to girls staring. Knock yourself out."
choices.reply: "Oh, bold. I like bold—it's a lovely mask. But I can't tell yet if there's wall behind it, or more of that sunshine." She winks, edging a shade more curious. "We'll see which you are."

choices.text: Back away and mumble that she's making you nervous.
choices.reply: "Nervous? Good—honest. I won't pounce, little light. A succubus who scares someone is a poor one; I'd rather you come to me on your own two feet." She steps back, giving you space. "When you're not trembling, find me again."

events.title: The Shared Dream
events.text: You open your eyes inside a dream too warm to be your own. Moonlight spills through an open window onto a bed piled with soft quilts, and Emilia is already there, a heart-shaped pillow in her lap, looking almost shy. "I didn't summon you, I promise," she says quickly. "You let me in—your heart was that open. So I built us somewhere cozy." She pats the pillow beside her. "No draining, no game. For once I want to share a warm dream with someone who stayed because they wanted to, not because I charmed them. Stay?" Her wings settle like a blanket, and the whole room holds its breath, waiting on your answer.

choices.text: Sit beside her and rest your head against hers.
choices.reply: "Oh." Her voice almost cracks. "That's the nicest thing a dream has ever given me. Stay as long as you like—I'll keep it warm." She leans into you, wings drawing close like an embrace.

choices.text: "Only if you promise to teach me how you do it."
choices.reply: "Teach you? Darling, that's flirtation upon flirtation—you want my craft and my secrets in one pillow night." She grins, pleased. "Careful. A girl could fall for that."

choices.text: "This is a trick, isn't it? To lower my guard."
choices.reply: A flicker of hurt crosses her face. "If I wanted your guard down, I wouldn't need a dream—I have charm and a lifetime of practice. I built this because I hoped you'd trust me." She turns away, smaller. "I'll wait."

events.title: Chosen, Not Taken
events.text: On the last night, Emilia meets you under the real moon, not a dream—and there's a tremor in her that has nothing to do with cold. "Every instinct I was born with whispers take, take, take," she says, gloved hands clasped tight. "But you're the first soul I've ever wanted to keep warm instead of to simply keep." Her voice drops, almost a prayer. "So I'm done with games. I'm not taking your soul, Yuuji. I'm asking if you'll give it—free, on purpose, because you choose me." She offers her hand, palm open, and beneath the moon her eyes are wet and honest. "Not a succubus's claim, not a charm. You. Me. Chosen, not taken. Say yes and stay until morning—that's the only contract I'll ever want."

choices.text: Take her hand and press it to your heart without a word.
choices.reply: "Yes. Yes—that's it, all of it." She laughs, bright and breaking, and presses her forehead to yours. "I didn't need a dream to know you're the warmest thing I'll ever hold. I love you, Yuuji—real, not woven."

choices.text: "I choose you, Emilia. Every dawn, on purpose."
choices.reply: "Then swear it with skin, not words—stay here with me, past first light." Her wings curve around you like a promise. "Just being chosen... I think that's how a succubus finally learns what her heart is for."

choices.text: "You've taken lots of things from dreams. How is this different?"
choices.reply: "Because this is the one thing I'm deliberately not taking. If I wanted it stolen, I'd have it by now—I'm asking because it only counts if you choose." She holds your gaze, steady. "The difference is you, walking up to the door on your own."
